research_name: Programmable Matrix Mathematics for Industrial Quality Monitoring
source_512_inverse: recorded original paceval matrix study in user-supplied PDF and archived project
new_sdk: Original C/C++ SDK interface from archived SDK files. Local binary unavailable for current run.
data_provenance: Results transcribed from actually returned 4.26 paceval MCP outputs; remote grid text has 10-digit decimal output formatting. TINC sample values use full returned digits. Matrix data are preserved from previous archived original local SDK execution; not newly rerun.
model_assumptions: 512-dimensional synthetic SPD covariance. Only first 3 channels carry residual. Model v2 includes an ad hoc quadratic penalty; illustrative thresholds are not a statistical test calibrated for v2. TINC bounds describe computational rounding, not measurement uncertainty.
